Name: Help Wanted Redux For 1.6
Author: weizinai
Description:
[size=6][b]Introduce[/b][/size]

[size=3]This mod enhances the daily quest board in front of the Seed Shop.[/size]

[size=6][b]Feature[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Replace the single help wanted quest with a list of quest notes stuck to the billboard.[/size]
[*][size=3]Require people to actually like (or even love) the items they request (optional)[/size]
[*][size=3]Ignore the game's restrictions on items to request (only one of the above is set)[/size]
[*][size=3]Set a max price for item requests (default -1 means disabled)[/size]
[*][size=3]Toggle allowing requests for artisan goods (default true)[/size]
[*][size=3]Toggle avoiding posting quests from NPCs with max hearts (default true) - only activates in single player mode[/size]
[*][size=3]Set a custom number of days allowed to complete help wanted quests (default 2)[/size]
[*][size=3]Set the max number of quests per day (default 10)([/size]Max number of quests per day is limited by the number of notes that can fit on the board within the configurable overlap parameters.)
[*][size=3]Change the relative chance of receiving any type of quest.([/size]Relative quest type chances are relative to each other.Slay monster quests are only available if one has unlocked the mine and played for at least 6 days.)
[*][size=3]Customize the default quest notes[/size]
[/list]
